title: Listening Drill — Hanging a test sign
description: Practical demonstration. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Hanging a test sign
sections.transcript:
INSTRUCTOR: This demonstration is about hanging a temporary sign. Watch the whole process once before trying it yourself. If you start while I'm still talking, you may miss the order of the steps.

INSTRUCTOR: Get the paper templates ready. Begin by checking the hook. When everything is in position, wait four minutes. It may look as though nothing is happening at first.

INSTRUCTOR: Look for an even gap before moving on. keep the doorway clear. Leave yourself time to clear the work area so the next group can start promptly.
